name: miao-vision
description: AI-first local data visualization with verified artifacts, an optional local Review Viewer, and optional data-story media.

interface.shortDescription: Verified artifacts with local review viewer
interface.longDescription: Turn local data into evidence-backed reports, posters, decks, and infographics without uploading source data. Optionally inspect workflow progress, evidence coverage, issues, revisions, and artifact previews in a local Review Viewer. Explicit media requests can optionally send a minimized prompt and approved reference images to ai-cli through Vercel AI Gateway to create explanatory images or single-shot videos.
